rationale: C07 plausibly supplied a material drafting template. Its opening provision closely matches the child's distinctive formulation of an honor issued “in the name of the President of the United States, as public evidence of deserved honor and distinction,” and both directives then establish related insignia that may be worn with the uniform. The child adapts C07's unit-citation machinery to individual White House service. C08 is also a strong secondary influence because it parallels the child's one-award limit, posthumous eligibility, service-secretary administration, and Defense-approved regulations. C25 shares award-establishment and accompanying-design language but has less similar administrative machinery.

shared_material.child_excerpt: a White House Service Certificate, to be awarded in the name of the President of the United States, as public evidence of deserved honor and distinction
shared_material.parent_excerpt: authorized to issue a citation in the name of the President of the United States, as public evidence of deserved honor and distinction
shared_material.explanation: This long, distinctive phrase is nearly verbatim and performs the same function of creating presidential recognition for military service.

shared_material.child_excerpt: A White House Service Badge ... is hereby established ... The badge may be worn as a part of the uniform
shared_material.parent_excerpt: Appropriate insignia ... may be displayed ... a ribbon identifying such citation shall be issued and shall become a permanent part of the uniform
shared_material.explanation: Both pair the presidential honor with identifying insignia and expressly regulate its display or wear with the uniform.

shared_material.child_excerpt: The White House Service Certificate shall ... be awarded by the Secretary of the Army, the Secretary of the Navy, or the Secretary of the Air Force
shared_material.parent_excerpt: The Secretaries of the Army, the Navy, and the Air Force, respectively, are hereby authorized to issue a citation
shared_material.explanation: The child retains the same service-by-service administration by the three military department secretaries while changing the eligible recipients and basis for recognition.
